faceless_void_distortion_field.name: Distortion Field
faceless_void_distortion_field.description: Enemy Attack Projectiles targetting Faceless Void or allied heroes within a %friendly_hero_distance% radius of him get slowed by %attack_projectile_slow%%%, when they get  within %slow_distance_max% distance of their target.

faceless_void_time_walk.name: Time Walk
faceless_void_time_walk.description: Rushes to a target location while backtracking any damage taken the last %backtrack_duration% seconds.
faceless_void_time_walk.scepter_description: Applies a Time Lock to all units at the landing destination.
faceless_void_time_walk.lore: Darkterror tears through the fabric of time, passing through Claszureme and instantly returning back.
faceless_void_time_walk.note0: While this ability is active, the hero is invulnerable.
faceless_void_time_walk.reverse_description: Available for 1.5 seconds after landing Time Walk. If used in this period, you will reverse your time walk back to your previous cast location. Does not affect health or proc scepter hits.
faceless_void_time_walk.reverse_custom_description: Can be used within 1.5s after Time Walk to return to the previous position.

faceless_void_time_dilation.name: Time Dilation
faceless_void_time_dilation.description: Faceless Void envelops nearby enemies with time dilating fields to slow cooldown progression of their abilities. Each enveloped enemy gains one Time Dilation stack when applied, and one stack per ability they have on cooldown. Each stack deals damage per second and slows movement and attack speed. The duration is paused while affected by Chronosphere.
faceless_void_time_dilation.shard_description: Increases slow per stack. Provides Faceless Void with stacks that increase his attack and movement speed. Amount of stacks is equal to the total amount of Time Dilation stacks applied to enemies at the moment of the cast and linearly fades out over the duration.
faceless_void_time_dilation.lore: For those who fight Darkterror, every moment stretches into eternity.
faceless_void_time_dilation.note1: Number of stacks can change during the effect. Casting an ability will provide a stack if it goes on cooldown. If an ability cooldown ends during Time Dilation, a stack will be removed.

faceless_void_time_lock.name: Time Lock
faceless_void_time_lock.description: Adds the chance for an attack to lock an enemy unit in time while attacking it a second time.
faceless_void_time_lock.lore: Darkterror’s strikes can knock his foes into another dimension.
faceless_void_time_lock.note0: Does not stack with Skull Basher.
faceless_void_time_lock.abilitydraft_note: In Ability Draft, does stack with Skull Basher.

faceless_void_chronosphere.name: Chronosphere
faceless_void_chronosphere.description: Creates a blister in spacetime, trapping all units caught in its sphere of influence and causes you to move very quickly inside it. Only Faceless Void and any units he controls are unaffected. Invisible enemies in the sphere will be revealed.
faceless_void_chronosphere.lore: When a passage to Claszureme opens, those caught inside rarely return.
faceless_void_chronosphere.note0: All units and buildings are frozen except those controlled by the caster.
faceless_void_chronosphere.note1: Faceless Void is not frozen inside the sphere, even if cast by another player.
faceless_void_chronosphere.abilitydraft_note: Faceless Void can move freely within the Chronosphere without drafting Chronosphere and regardless of team.
